issues.title: Redundant post-query image filter in loadArtistShowcase
issues.description: packages/core/src/services/artist-showcase.ts:69-102 already filters at the DB level with `where: { image: { not: null } }`, then re-filters the same array in JS (`.filter((g): g is ... => g.image != null)`) purely to narrow the TypeScript type. Harmless but slightly confusing — a reader might wonder if the where clause is trusted.
issues.suggested_fix: Either add a short comment noting the filter is a type-narrowing no-op (DB already excludes nulls), or use a non-null assertion with a comment instead of a redundant filter.

issues.title: Pre-mortem risk 2 (repeated-tap sluggishness) not mitigated
issues.description: The plan's pre-mortem noted a risk that repeated taps on the same artist could feel sluggish, with a ready mitigation to memoize the last-fetched showcase by artist id in KioskApp state. openShowcase() in KioskApp.tsx always clears showcase to null and re-fetches on every tap, even for the same artist reopened moments later.
issues.suggested_fix: If manual testing on the tablet shows noticeable lag on reopen, add a one-line memo (e.g. skip re-fetch when showcaseArtistId === artistId and showcase is already loaded) per the pre-mortem's stated mitigation.
